name: OPTICA-FORGE
subtitle: Physical Wave Optics, Holographic Interference & Thin-Film Studio

dualAuditSignOff.technicalAuditor: PASSED (Remediated complex extinction coefficient in TMM, NaN guards on metallic layers, dirty flag eliminating static CPU churn, and one-shot chime compressor routing)
dualAuditSignOff.productQualityAuditor: PASSED (Remediated TMM spectrum percentage formatting, added Spectrum RGB colormap palette, verified physical optics observables)

opticalEngines.waveOpticsEngine: 2D scalar wave propagation with Huygens-Fresnel integral, secondary wavelet emitter synthesis, optical irradiance I=|E|^2, and phase angle atan2(Im, Re)
opticalEngines.interferometryEngine: Michelson two-beam interference with piezo nanometer scanning and coherence decay, Mach-Zehnder test cell refractometry, and Fabry-Pérot multi-beam resonant cavity Airy function
opticalEngines.thinFilmEngine: Exact 2x2 Transfer Matrix Method (TMM) spectral engine with complex refractive index admittance supporting TE/TM/unpolarized light and angle of incidence theta_0 in [0, 75] deg across 380-780nm
opticalEngines.digitalHolography: Off-axis Leith-Upatnieks reference beam recording and conjugate readout wave 3D virtual image reconstruction

interactiveSystems.visualizer: 60fps HTML5 Canvas with ref-based zero-GC offscreen pipeline and pre-computed palettes (Laser Green, Cyan Neon, Solar Amber, Spectrum RGB, Phase Wheel)
interactiveSystems.detectorAnalyzer: Dynamic SVG slice plotting detector cross-section irradiance I(y) with peak intensity, fringe visibility V, and Airy radius r1
interactiveSystems.thinFilmSpectrumPlot: Dynamic SVG plot of visible reflectance R(lambda) and transmittance T(lambda) with real-time laser wavelength marker
interactiveSystems.opticalSonification: 100% procedural Web Audio laser pink noise hiss, Doppler fringe velocity tone, and cavity resonance drone with master dynamics limiter
interactiveSystems.telemetryExport: CSV export of detector irradiance profile, CSV export of thin-film spectrum, and JSON bench state export
